profile.topic_one_line: Allotment of advertisement display rights on 3 MCD subways for 3 years on monthly licence fee (highest bidder wins)
profile.commercial_model: H1 – highest Monthly Licence Fee (MLF) per subway, above reserve price
profile.authority: Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) – Advertisement Department
profile.parent_body: Commercial Officer (Advtt.), Dr. SPM Civic Centre, New Delhi

key_facts_table: Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD), Advertisement Department
Open e-tender for allotment of advertisement rights through designated subways on **Monthly Licence Fee (MLF)** basis
==**3 years**, extendable by **2 years** on satisfactory performance==
==**H-1: highest MLF quoted**, separately for each subway; bid for one, some or all==
Two bid (Technical + Financial), online; bid validity **180 days**

rows: 26.04.2023, 15:00 Hrs – MCD Conference Room, 25th Floor, Civic Centre

sections.heading: Sites, Reserve Price and Eligibility per Site

rows: 1. Jahagirpuri Metro to Azadpur Metro, Civil Line Zone
2. Rohtak Road near Ashoka Park Metro, KBZ & KPZ
3. Near ITI Arab Ki Sarai & Nizamuddin PS, Central Zone

blocks.text: Each subway: total advertisement area **500 sq. ft.**, maximum **250 sq. ft. per side**, parallel to road.

items.text: Proprietorship, partnership, registered society / co-operative, public or private limited company.
==No dues pending to MCD / erstwhile MCDs and not blacklisted by MCD, NDMC, EDMC, SDMC or any Govt body/PSU== (notarised affidavit required).
++**No losses in the last three financial years.**++
++Net worth (as on **31.03.2022**) at least **25% of the annual reserve price** of the sites bid for.++
++Average annual turnover at least the site-wise figure above (any 3 FYs from **2017-18 to 2021-22**); for several sites the amounts are added up.++
Bids are opened in the bidder's order of preference (Annexure 7) until its turnover / net-worth capacity is used up.
Must register with MCD Advertisement Dept. in the appropriate category within **10 working days** of the offer letter.
==**Security deposit: 2 × MLF** per site within **12 working days** of offer letter (BG valid 39 months).==
==**2 months' advance MLF** within **10 working days** of offer letter; thereafter MLF paid **bi-monthly in advance**.==
**10% increase** in MLF from the 3rd year, and 10% every year in any extension.
Late payment interest **24% p.a.** (2% per month, full month charged even for 1 day); cancellation if unpaid 7 days after due date.
GST / other taxes payable over and above the quoted MLF.
Agreement within **12 working days** of offer letter; incubation period **15 days** from allotment letter (not extendable).
All structure, fabrication, electrical work and structural design at the bidder's cost; structures become **MCD property** at contract end.
Display along the wall, parallel to road; minimum ground clearance **4 ft**, maximum height **14 ft**; comply with **Outdoor Advertisement Policy 2017** and DMC bye-laws.
Own electricity connection or solar; **no generator sets**.
**No subletting**; monthly display statements and quarterly self-declaration to MCD.
Mandatory display of MCD logo, site code, advertiser name, size, lat-long and allotment details.
Surrender: **90 days' notice**, not before **9 months** of contract; surrendering bidder barred for 2 terms. MCD may cancel with one month's notice.

summary: MCD's Advertisement Department invited e-bids (NIT dated 18.04.2023) for 3-year advertisement rights on three Delhi subways, awarded to the highest monthly licence fee above reserve prices of ₹52,000–₹1,93,500. Bids closed on 10.05.2023, 16:00 Hrs, with site-wise EMD of ₹56,000–₹2,08,900 and a ₹5,000 tender fee per site. Key disqualifiers: any dues or blacklisting with MCD bodies, losses in any of the last 3 years, and turnover / net worth below the site-wise thresholds.
